an3.123:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kusinārāyam viharati Baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe.
an3.123:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:-Bhikkhavo ti.
an3.123:2.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
an3.123:2.2: Tam enaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā svātanāya bhattena nimanteti.
an3.123:2.4: So tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkamati. Upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdati.
an3.123:2.5: Tam enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāreti.
an3.123:3.2: Sādhu vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāretī ti. Evam pi 'ssa hoti:-- aho vata myāyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā
an3.123:3.4: āyatim pi evarūpena paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappeyya sampavāreyyā ti.
an3.123:3.5: So taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhopanno anādīnavadassāvī anissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
an3.123:3.6: So tattha kāmavitakkam pi vitakketi vyāpādavitakkam pi vitakketi vihiṃsāvitakkam pi vitakketi.
an3.123:3.7: Evarūpassāhaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno dinnaṃ na mahapphalan ti vadāmi.
an3.123:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
an3.123:4.2: Tam enaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā svātanāya bhattena nimanteti.
an3.123:4.4: So tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkamati. Upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdati.
an3.123:4.5: Tam enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāreti.
an3.123:5.2: sādhu vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāretī ti.
an3.123:5.4: -aho vata māyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā āyatiṃ pi evarūpena paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappeyya sampavāreyyā ti.
an3.123:5.5: So taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ agathito amucchito anajjhopanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati.
an3.123:5.6: So tattha nekkhammavitakkam pi vitakketi avyāpādavitakkam pi vitakketi avihiṃsāvitakkam pi vitakketi.
an3.123:5.7: Evarūpassāhaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti vadāmi.
